messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Discussion on whole-genome-2-7m-array
parts:
Hi Steve,

technically aroma.affymetrix should be able to handle the
Cytogenetics_Array chip type. I have recently added more tests for
this chip type as part of aroma.affymetrix's redundancy and system
tests. This assures the technical support. The chip type has its own
page (we're moving away from Google Group):

http://aroma-project.org/chipTypes/Cytogenetics_Array

Technical support is not the same as saying there is a ready and
evaluated statistical preprocessing method available. For instance,
the assay for Cytogenetics_Array does not involve restriction enzymes,
making normalization for PCR fragment-lengths effects as done in CRMA
(v1/2) irrelevant. Work is needed here.

/Henrik
